name: Grappa
description: Always-on IRC bouncer with a REST-first API and an irssi-style PWA client.

notes.text: Grappa is currently beta/pre-alpha software; test it before using it for production IRC access.
The installer uses Docker inside an unprivileged LXC and enables nesting, keyctl and mknod support. FUSE remains disabled by default.
Back up the Grappa data and GRAPPA_ENCRYPTION_KEY together; losing the encryption key makes stored upstream credentials unrecoverable.
For public access, put Grappa behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.
Set Public Hostname to the DNS name used by the reverse proxy. Leaving it blank uses the container IP for LAN access.
Updates are manual and move to the latest stable GitHub release after checking container health.
